name: @builderforce/workspace-path
description: The one validator for a workspace-relative file path used as an R2 key: rejects anything that could escape the project prefix or produce a key that can never round-trip (empty, absolute, backslashes, ./.. segments, empty segments, trailing slash, control characters, overlong). Shared by the API's workspace store and the legacy worker's file router so the two edges accept exactly the same paths. Source-only, dependency-free.
